page: Google Cloud Platform m3-ultramem-64 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the m3 family. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.6 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes hyper-threading, a 54 MB L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 vector instructions and AES cryptography. It is equipped with 1952 GB of dedicated system memory, translating to 30.5 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, as evidenced by high scores in multi-threaded stress-ng tests, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU evaluations. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, static web serving throughput, and software compilation. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall within the average range. LLM inference speeds are strong for prompt processing on small models and text generation on medium models, while remaining average for larger models.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of over 30 GB per core, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into deployment architectures. It is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy data processing, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound analytical workloads.
